name: Tress
summary: A young woman from a remote island on the spore-covered world of Lumar, where she lives a simple life as a cupwasher. When her love, the adventurous Charlie, is kidnapped and cursed by the Sorceress of the Midnight Sea, Tress leaves her sheltered home for the first time and embarks on a perilous journey across the dangerous spore seas. Crewed by a motley assortment of pirates, dragons, and a talking rat, she discovers unexpected depths of courage, resourcefulness, and determination. Narrated by Hoid with characteristic wit, Tress's journey from ordinary cupwasher to legendary explorer is a celebration of the idea that anyone can become a hero when they have something worth fighting for.
